_doc: Corrections to the official 4 PM portfolio close for dates whose committed is_close snapshot was taken at the wrong time. Read by performance._eod_close_curve (Gate 2) and mirrored into Supabase portfolio_snapshots.close_value by the owner (SQL in RELEASE_NOTES.md). Git history is append-only, so the bad snapshot commits stay; this file overrides them on read. Each value = cash + sum(qty x official close), qty and cash from that day's EOD snapshot (unchanged Nov 2-4: no fills), closes from Polygon grouped-daily (adjusted) fetched 2026-11-05.
